name: BoxLine Equipment
about: Sells and installs packaging machines for small and mid-size manufacturers across Maharashtra and nearby states.

products.name: Carton sealer
products.use: Tapes the top and bottom of cartons for dispatch; fixed-size and random-size models.

products.name: Shrink wrapper
products.use: Wraps products or multi-packs (bottles, snack packets) in shrink film with a heat tunnel.

products.name: Strapping machine
products.use: Puts plastic straps around cartons and bales to hold them tight for transport.

products.name: Stretch wrapper
products.use: Wraps loaded pallets in stretch film on a turntable so they stay stable in transit.

products.name: Band sealer
products.use: Heat-seals filled pouches (spices, snacks, ghee, bakery) continuously on a conveyor.

products.name: Labelling machine
products.use: Applies wrap-around or front/back labels on bottles, jars and tubes.
